info.title: TravelMapster API
info.description: The JSON API the TravelMapster app uses. It is version 1 and changes only in backward-compatible ways ([ADR 0019](../adr/0019-api-description-and-versioning.md)). Errors are `{ "error": "…" }` with a matching status; every response is `Cache-Control: no-store` unless stated.

get.summary: CSRF token for the current session

post.summary: Create an account and sign in

400.description: Invalid credentials, or a sign-up refused by the honeypot field

post.description: Rate limited per client IP by the sign-in limit and its own, tighter sign-up limit per hour.

401.description: Unknown username or wrong password, alike

post.summary: Change the password; signs out other sessions

400.description: Invalid new password or wrong current one

delete.summary: Delete the account and all its data

get.summary: Everything the account holds, for the data archive

post.summary: Save a place, optionally with visits
Import up to 1,000 places with their visits

413.description: More than 1,000 places, or a body over 3 MB

post.summary: Create, change and remove places all or nothing

404.description: A place to change or remove is not the caller's; nothing is kept

patch.summary: Change a place; fields left out keep their value
patch.description: Visits are left alone unless an old client sends `travelDate`.

delete.summary: Remove a place and its visits

get.summary: Visits of a place, newest first

post.summary: Add a visit to a place

get.summary: History of visit dates, newest first (latest 5,000)

404.description: No public map by that name; private and missing look alike

get.summary: Search every town in the map data

session.name: travelmapster.sid
session.description: Session cookie set by sign-in (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax).

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: Required on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE: the token from `GET /api/csrf-token` or the last auth response.

CsrfRejected.description: Missing or wrong CSRF token (`code: CSRF`)

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this client IP; standard `RateLimit` headers say when to retry

code.description: `CSRF` when the CSRF token is missing or wrong.

password.description: At most 72 bytes in UTF-8; never trimmed.

website.description: Sign-up only: a honeypot field people never see. Anything in it refuses the sign-up.

csrfToken.description: The token for the new session.

ProfileChanges.description: Each setting is optional; send at least one.

homeCountry.description: A map code, or null or empty to clear it.

endDate.description: On or after the start; empty when not recorded or still going on.

ongoing.description: Still there: no end date yet.

stay.description: How the traveler was at a place been to (ADR 0014); always `visit` for the wishlist.

tags.description: Lowercased; letters and digits with inner spaces, dashes, apostrophes or ampersands.

travelDate.description: Legacy single date (ADR 0009): becomes a visit; on an update it only ever adds one.

visits.description: Creating and importing only; wins over travelDate.

BulkChanges.description: Between 1 and 300 changes in all, applied all or nothing; each place changed or removed at most once.

LedgerRule.description: A stay rule (`kind: stay`, at most maxDays in any windowDays) or a threshold (`kind: threshold`, over a year from yearStart or a rolling window).

markers.description: Without notes, photo links, ratings, tags, emoji, wishlist plans or hidden places.
